content: Camera micro-feel vs motion sickness: the nausea triggers are visual motion the body did not perform - head bob, camera shake, weapon sway, motion blur, narrow FOV, and automatic camera angle changes (Xbox Accessibility Guideline 117 requires toggles/sliders for each). Third-person/top-down cameras are far more tolerant than first-person, but sustained oscillation of the CAMERA is riskier than animating the CHARACTER (idle breathing on the model is safe; idle sway of the camera is not). FOV kicks are safe when brief (fractions of a second, spring-back) and small (a few degrees); persistent FOV change and long shakes are the offenders. Provide toggles for any continuous camera motion. Sources: learn.microsoft.com XAG 117, bugnet.io FOV article, switchbladegaming.com.
